name: P2P Stream
description: Stream torrents straight into Jellyfin. Built-in torrent sources (no extra software), TMDB catalogs as libraries, search for any movie or show from the Jellyfin search bar, and Burst-style quality filters.

versions.changelog: Torrents tab: each tracker's last answer and the DHT state, to see why a torrent finds no peers. Trackers sharing one tier are split so they're all tried at once.
Torrents tab shows why a torrent errored (e.g. disk full); playback no longer hangs on an errored torrent. Engine tab shows how much space the download folder takes.

Privacy: send torrent traffic only through a VPN interface (with a kill switch) or only through a SOCKS5/HTTP proxy. Share only while watching; disk space limit. Per-device limits for Auto (e.g. TV up to 1080p). Trakt catalogs (trending, popular, anticipated, box office, watchlist, lists; connect your account for private watchlist and recommendations). Anime: Nyaa searched with romaji titles; season 2 releases no longer offered for season 1.

Faster start: opening a title's page pre-loads Auto's release (setting, on by default). Torrents stop downloading a minute after nobody is reading them. Source health on the Sources tab (results or the reason a site failed). Tidier settings page: cards in three columns, less scrolling.

Best 4K / Best 1080p / Best 720p choices in the Version menu. Streaming-friendly sizes: well-seeded, reasonably sized releases are tried before huge remuxes. The stream list always keeps the best releases of every resolution.

New sources: Knaben (many trackers at once) and Nyaa (anime). Much faster search (movies first, then each show's first episode; no full library scans). Backup addresses for sites that move or get blocked (YTS now via yts.pw). Clearer Test search. Removed BT4G.
Add source: your own RSS feeds and Torznab indexers (Prowlarr/Jackett) in the Sources list, with edit and remove. Removed 1337x.
Search tab works like the Catalogs tab (pick a library or New library...). Auto shows its video/audio details once the release it will play has been checked, and names that release.
Search: runs before other plugins' search hooks (e.g. Gelato), and works before the search libraries exist by adding matches to a catalog folder that's already in a library.

Choosing a version now plays it. Several readers per stream (probe, playback, subtitles no longer knock each other off). Gelato-style check of the top streams' tracks. Leftover downloads from crashes are cleaned up at startup. More readable Torrents and Sources tabs.

Available streams picker (Elementum-style): a title's releases appear in Jellyfin's Version menu with resolution, size, seeds, quality and source. Auto (best match) stays the default; the stream you pick is remembered.
New catalogs: Trending Today (TMDB's daily trending list) for movies and shows.
Fix playback: a cancelled probe left the torrent stream locked, so every play request failed with HTTP 500 (black screen, then playback error).
Gelato-style settings page (tabs, catalogs table, New library folders, unsaved-changes bar); built-in sources incl. KickAss, BT4G, 1337x; Jellyfin search integration; Burst-style quality filters.
